title: [main] - Incorrect Prepayment Invoice Amount for Sales Orders with Invoice Discount, Prices Including VAT and negative non-inventory line.
summary: Fixes incorrect prepayment invoice amounts for sales orders with invoice discounts, prices including VAT, and negative non-inventory lines by computing expected prepayment amounts line-by-line instead of from the order header.
key_points: Prepayment calculation now uses each line's Amount and Prepayment % instead of header-level amounts
Excludes negative and non-prepayment lines from prepayment base calculation
Handles mixed prepayment percentages correctly across order lines
Rounding correction only applies when there is genuine rounding surplus
Fixes regression where posted prepayment invoices were understated
quote: Compute the expected prepayment amount line by line from the actual prepayment lines, using each line's own Amount and Prepayment %
